description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProviderConnectorInterface, an interface in PHP that specifies how external OAuth providers should be integrated within the SuiteCRM project. It includes method signatures for obtaining provider IDs, URLs, tokens, and configuration details related to OAuth2 authentication flows.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderConnectorInterface
classes.description: Defines methods for OAuth provider integration, including obtaining provider ID, type, authorization URL, access tokens, and configuration details.

methods.name: getProviderID
methods.description: Returns the provider identifier as a string.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the provider type as a string.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates the authorization URL based on client ID and secret.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token using the authorization code.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using a refresh token.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps an AccessTokenInterface object to an internal array format.

methods.name: getClientID
methods.description: Determines the applicable client ID based on provided configuration.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Determines the applicable client secret based on provided configuration.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Provides the redirect URI for OAuth flow.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Provides options for building the authorization URL.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Provides options for the token request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the OAuth grant type for token requests.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Initializes and returns an OAuth provider instance.
